title: Ricercar a 3

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the royal theme alone, in the soprano, on C.
☞ The answer in the alto, on G; the theme's G is answered by C.
☞ Third voice: the theme in the bass, on C.
☞ After a long episode, the theme in the bass, on G.
☞ The theme in the soprano, on F, in F minor.
☞ After the longest episode, the theme in the soprano, on C.
☞ The last entry: the theme in the bass, on C.

listenFor: 3 voices; the royal theme ten times, between long free episodes
